sloka: सत्यं ते प्रतिजानामि भ्रातृतुल्यो ऽधिको ऽपि वा ।भविष्याम्योजसा चैव सन्तापं त्यज हृद्गतम् ।। ७.९.४५ ॥
transliteration: satyaṁ te pratijānāmi bhrātṛtulyo 'dhiko 'pi vā ।bhaviṣyāmyojasā caiva santāpaṁ tyaja hṛdgatam ।। 7.9.45 ॥

translations.english: "Truly, I promise you that I shall become either equal to or even superior to my brother in might; therefore, abandon the sorrow residing in your heart."
